name: BIOS Information
brief: BIOS vendor, release, capabilities and ROM size.

fields.name: Vendor
fields.description: String number of the BIOS Vendors Name.

fields.name: Version
fields.description: String number of the BIOS Version. This is a freeform string that may contain Core and OEM version information.

fields.name: StartingSegment
fields.description: Segment location of BIOS starting address (for example, 0E800h). NOTE: The size of the runtime BIOS image can be computed by subtracting the Starting Address Segment from 10000h and multiplying the result by 16.

fields.name: ReleaseDate
fields.description: String number of the BIOS release date. The date string, if supplied, is in either mm/dd/yy or mm/dd/yyyy format. If the year portion of the string is two digits, the year is assumed to be 19yy. NOTE: The mm/dd/yyyy format is required for SMBIOS version 2.3 and later.

fields.name: BiosRomSize
fields.description: Size (n) where 64K * (n+1) is the size of the physical device containing the BIOS, in bytes

fields.name: Characteristics
fields.description: Defines which functions the BIOS supports: PCI, PCMCIA, Flash, etc.

fields.name: ExtensionBytes
fields.description: Optional space reserved for future supported functions. The number of Extension Bytes that are present is indicated by the Length in offset 1 minus 12h.For version 2.4 and later implementations, two BIOS Characteristics Extension Bytes are defined (12-13h) and bytes 14- 17h are also defined

fields.name: SystemBIOSMajorRelease
fields.description: Identifies the major release of the System BIOS; for example, the value is 0Ah for revision 10.22 and 02h for revision 2.1. This field and/or the System BIOS Minor Release field is updated each time a System BIOS update for a given system is released. If the system does not support the use of this field, the value is 0FFh for both this field and the System BIOS Minor Release field.

fields.name: SystemBIOSMinorRelease
fields.description: Identifies the minor release of the System BIOS; for example, the value is 16h for revision 10.22 and 01h for revision 2.1.

fields.name: EmbeddedControllerFirmwareMajorRelease
fields.description: Identifies the major release of the embedded controller firmware; for example, the value would be 0Ah for revision 10.22 and 02h for revision 2.1. This field and/or the Embedded Controller Firmware Minor Release field is updated each time an embedded controller firmware update for a given system is released. If the system does not have field upgradeable embedded controller firmware, the value is 0FFh.

fields.name: EmbeddedControllerFirmwareMinorRelease
fields.description: Identifies the minor release of the embedded controller firmware; for example, the value is 16h for revision 10.22 and 01h for revision 2.1. If the system does not have field upgradeable embedded controller firmware, the value is 0FFh.

fields.name: ExtendedBiosRomSize
fields.description: Extended BIOS ROM size. Used when BiosRomSize is FFh. Bits 13:0 contain the size, and bits 15:14 select MB or GB units.

name: System Information
brief: System manufacturer, product, UUID and identifying strings.

fields.name: Manufacturer
fields.description: Number of Null terminated string

fields.name: ProductName
fields.description: Number of Null terminated string

fields.name: Version
fields.description: Number of Null terminated string

fields.name: SerialNumber
fields.description: Number of Null terminated string

fields.name: UUID
fields.description: Universal Unique ID number, A UUID is an identifier that is designed to be unique across both time and space. It requires no central registration process. The UUID is 128 bits long. Its format is described in RFC 4122, but the actual field contents are opaque and not significant to the SMBIOS specification, which is only concerned with the byte order.

fields.name: WakeUpType
fields.description: Identifies the event that caused the system to power up.

fields.name: SKUNumber
fields.description: Number of Null terminated string This text string is used to identify a particular computer configuration for sale. It is sometimes also called a product ID or purchase order number. This number is frequently found in existing fields, but there is no standard format. Typically for a given system board from a given OEM, there are tens of unique processor, memory, hard drive, and optical drive configurations.

fields.name: Family
fields.description: Number of Null terminated string This text string is used to identify the family a particular computer belongs to. A family refers to a set of computers that are similar but not identical from a hardware or software point of view. Typically, a family is composed of different computer models, which have different configurations and pricing points. Computers in the same family often have similar branding and cosmetic features

fields.name: Manufacturer
fields.description: Number of Null terminated string

fields.name: Product

fields.name: Version

fields.name: SerialNumber
fields.description: Number of Null terminated string

fields.name: AssetTag

fields.name: FeatureFlags
fields.description: A collection of flags that identify features of this baseboard.

fields.name: LocationinChassis
fields.description: Number of a null-terminated string that describes this board's location within the chassis referenced by the Chassis Handle NOTE: This field supports a CIM_Container class mapping where: LocationWithinContainer is this field. GroupComponent is the chassis referenced by Chassis Handle. PartComponent is this baseboard.

fields.name: ChassisHandle
fields.description: The handle, or instance number, associated with the chassis in which this board resides

fields.name: BoardType
fields.description: Identifies the type of board

fields.name: NumberofContainedObjectHandles
fields.description: Identifies the number (0 to 255) of Contained Object Handles that follow

name: System Enclosure or Chassis
brief: Chassis type, manufacturer, asset identity and reported state.

fields.name: Manufacturer
fields.description: Number of Null terminated string

fields.name: _Type
fields.description: Bit 7 Chassis lock is present if 1. Otherwise, either a lock is not present or it is unknown if the enclosure has a lock. Bits 6:0 Enumeration value.

fields.name: Version
fields.description: Number of Null terminated string

fields.name: SerialNumber
fields.description: Number of Null terminated string

fields.name: AssetTagNumber
fields.description: Number of Null terminated string

fields.name: BootUpState
fields.description: Identifies the state of the enclosure when it was last booted.

fields.name: PowerSupplyState
fields.description: Identifies the state of the enclosures power supply (or supplies) when last booted.

fields.name: ThermalState
fields.description: Identifies the enclosures thermal state when last booted.

fields.name: SecurityStatus
fields.description: Identifies the enclosures physical security status when last booted.

fields.name: OEM_Defined
fields.description: Contains OEM- or BIOS vendor-specific information.

fields.name: Height
fields.description: The height of the enclosure, in 'U's. A U is a standard unit of measure for the height of a rack or rack-mountable component and is equal to 1.75 inches or 4.445 cm. A value of 00h indicates that the enclosure height is unspecified.

fields.name: NumberofPowerCords
fields.description: Identifies the number of power cords associated with the enclosure or chassis. A value of 00h indicates that the number is unspecified.

fields.name: ContainedElementCount
fields.description: Identifies the number of Contained Element records that follow, in the range 0 to 255. Each Contained Element group comprises m bytes, as specified by the Contained Element Record Length field that follows. If no Contained Elements are included, this field is set to 0.

fields.name: ContainedElementRecordLength
fields.description: Identifies the byte length of each Contained Element record that follows, in the range 0 to 255. If no Contained Elements are included, this field is set to 0. For version 2.3.2 and later of this specification, this field is set to at least 03h when Contained Elements are specified.

name: Processor Information
brief: Processor sockets, families, core counts and linked caches.

fields.name: SocketDesignation
fields.description: String number for Reference Designation EXAMPLE: J202,0

fields.name: ProcessorManufacturer
fields.description: String number of Processor Manufacturer

fields.name: ProcessorID
fields.description: Raw processor identification data. The Processor ID field contains processor-specific information that describes the processors features. x86-Class CPUs For x86 class CPUs, the fields format depends on the processors support of the CPUID instruction. If the instruction is supported, the Processor ID field contains two DWORD-formatted values. The first (offsets 08h-0Bh) is the EAX value returned by a CPUID instruction with input EAX set to 1; the second (offsets 0Ch-0Fh) is the EDX value returned by that instruction. Otherwise, only the first two bytes of the Processor ID field are significant (all others are set to 0) and contain (in WORD-format) the contents of the DX register at CPU reset.

fields.name: ProcessorVersion
fields.description: String number describing the Processor

fields.name: Voltaje
fields.description: Two forms of information can be specified by the SMBIOS in this field, dependent on the value present in bit 7 (the most-significant bit). If bit 7 is 0 (legacy mode), the remaining bits of the field represent the specific voltages that the processor socket can accept.

fields.name: ExternalClock
fields.description: External Clock Frequency, in MHz. If the value is unknown, the field is set to 0.

fields.name: MaxSpeed
fields.description: Maximum processor speed (in MHz) supported by the system for this processor socket. 0E9h for a 233 MHz processor. If the value is unknown, the field is set to 0. NOTE: This field identifies a capability for the system, not the processor itself.

fields.name: CurrentSpeed
fields.description: Same format as Max Speed NOTE: This field identifies the processor's speed at system boot, and the Processor ID field implies the processor's additional speed characteristics (that is, single speed or multiple speed).

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Bit 7 Reserved, must be zero Bit 6 CPU Socket Populated 1 CPU Socket Populated 0 CPU Socket Unpopulated Bits 5:3 Reserved, must be zero Bits 2:0 CPU Status 0h Unknown 1h CPU Enabled 2h CPU Disabled by User through BIOS Setup 3h CPU Disabled By BIOS (POST Error) 4h CPU is Idle, waiting to be enabled. 5-6h Reserved 7h Other

fields.name: L1CacheHandle
fields.description: The handle of a Cache Information structure that defines the attributes of the primary (Level 1) cache for this processor. For version 2.1 and version 2.2 implementations, the value is 0FFFFh if the processor has no L1 cache. For version 2.3 and later implementations, the value is 0FFFFh if the Cache Information structure is not provided.

fields.name: L2CacheHandle
fields.description: The handle of a Cache Information structure that defines the attributes of the secondary (Level 2) cache for this processor. For version 2.1 and version 2.2 implementations, the value is 0FFFFh if the processor has no L2 cache. For version 2.3 and later implementations, the value is 0FFFFh if the Cache Information structure is not provided.

fields.name: L3CacheHandle
fields.description: The handle of a Cache Information structure that defines the attributes of the tertiary (Level 3) cache for this processor. For version 2.1 and version 2.2 implementations, the value is 0FFFFh if the processor has no L3 cache. For version 2.3 and later implementations, the value is 0FFFFh if the Cache Information structure is not provided.

fields.name: SerialNumber
fields.description: String number for the serial number of this processor. This value is set by the manufacturer and normally not changeable.

fields.name: AssetTag
fields.description: String number for the asset tag of this processor.

fields.name: PartNumber
fields.description: String number for the part number of this processor. This value is set by the manufacturer and normally not changeable.

fields.name: CoreCount
fields.description: Number of cores per processor socket. If the value is unknown, the field is set to 0. Co Count is the number of cores detected by the BIOS for this processor socket. It does not necessarily indicate the full capability of the processor. For example, platform hardware may have the capability to limit the number of cores reported by the processor without BIOS intervention or knowledge. For a dual processor installed in a platform where the hardware is set to limit it to one core, the BIOS reports a value of 1 in Core Count. For a dual-core processor with multi-core support disabled by BIOS, the BIOS reports a value of 2 in Core Count.

fields.name: CoreEnabled
fields.description: Number of enabled cores per processor socket.�If the value is unknown, the field is set 0. Core Enabled is the number of cores that are enabled by the BIOS and available for Operating System use. For example, if the BIOS detects a dual-core processor, it would report a value of 2 if it leaves both cores enabled, and it would report a value of 1 if it disables multi-core support.

fields.name: ThreadCount
fields.description: Number of threads per processor socket. If the value is unknown, the field is set to 0. Thread Count is the total number of threads detected by the BIOS for this processor socket. It is a processor-wide count, not a thread-per-core count. It does not necessarily indicate the full capability of the processor. For example, platform hardware may have the capability to limit the number of threads reported by the processor without BIOS intervention or knowledge. For a dual-thread processor installed in a platform where the hardware is set to limit it to one thread, the BIOS reports a value of 1 in Thread Count. For a dual-thread processor with multi-threading disabled by BIOS, the BIOS reports a value of 2 in Thread Count. For a dual-core, dual-thread-per-core processor, the BIOS reports a value of 4 in Thread Count.

fields.name: ProcessorCharacteristics
fields.description: Defines which functions the processor supports.

fields.name: ProcessorFamily2
fields.description: Extended processor family value. This field is used when ProcessorFamily is FEh.

fields.name: CoreCount2
fields.description: Extended core count. Used when CoreCount is FFh.

fields.name: CoreEnabled2
fields.description: Extended enabled core count. Used when CoreEnabled is FFh.

fields.name: ThreadCount2
fields.description: Extended thread count. Used when ThreadCount is FFh.

fields.name: ThreadEnabled
fields.description: Number of enabled threads per processor socket.

name: Memory Controller Information

fields.name: ErrorDetectingMethod
fields.description: ENUM

fields.name: ErrorCorrectingCapability
fields.description: Bit Field

fields.name: SupportedInterleave
fields.description: ENUM

fields.name: CurrentInterleave
fields.description: ENUM

fields.name: MaximumMemoryModuleSize
fields.description: Size of the largest memory module supported (per slot), specified as n, where 2**n is the maximum size in MB The maximum amount of memory supported by this controller is that value times the number of slots, as specified in offset 0Eh of this structure.

fields.name: SupportedSpeeds
fields.description: Bit Field

fields.name: SupportedMemoryTypes
fields.description: Bit Field

fields.name: MemoryModuleVoltage
fields.description: Describes the required voltages for each of the memory module sockets controlled by this controller: Bits 7:3 Reserved, must be zero Bit 2���� 2.9V Bit 1���� 3.3V Bit 0���� 5V NOTE: Setting of multiple bits indicates that the sockets are configurable.

fields.name: NumberofAssociatedMemorySlots
fields.description: Defines how many of the Memory Module Information blocks are controlled by this controller

fields.name: MemoryModuleConfigurationHandles
fields.description: Lists memory information structure handles controlled by this controller

fields.name: EnabledErrorCorrectingCapabilities
fields.description: Identifies the error-correcting capabilities that were enabled when the structure was built

name: Memory Module Information
brief: Legacy module size, speed and error status.

fields.name: SocketDesignation
fields.description: String number for reference designation EXAMPLE: �J202�,0

fields.name: BankConnections
fields.description: Each nibble indicates a bank (RAS#) connection; 0xF means no connection. EXAMPLE: If banks 1 & 3 (RAS# 1 & 3) were connected to a SIMM socket the byte for that socket would be 13h. If only bank 2 (RAS 2) were connected, the byte for that socket would be 2Fh.

fields.name: CurrentSpeed
fields.description: Speed of the memory module, in ns (for example, 70d for a 70ns module) If the speed is unknown, the field is set to 0.

fields.name: CurrentMemoryType
fields.description: This field describes the physical characteristics of the memory modules that are supported by (and currently installed in) the system

fields.name: InstalledSize
fields.description: The Installed Size fields identify the size of the memory module that is installed in the socket, as determined by reading and correlating the module�s presence-detect information. If the system does not support presence-detect mechanisms, the Installed Size field is set to 7Dh to indicate that the installed size is not determinable.

fields.name: EnabledSize
fields.description: The Enabled Size field identifies the amount of memory currently enabled for the system�s use from the module. If a module is known to be installed in a connector, but all memory in the module has been disabled due to error, the Enabled Size field is set to 7Eh.

fields.name: ErrorStatus
fields.description: Bits 7:3 Reserved, set to 0s Bit 2 If set, the Error Status information should be obtained from the event log; bits 1 and 0 are reserved. Bit 1 Correctable errors received for the module, if set. This bit is reset only during a system reset. Bit 0 Uncorrectable errors received for the module, if set. All or a portion of the module has been disabled. This bit is only reset on power-on.

name: Cache Information
brief: Cache level, installed capacity, associativity and error correction.

fields.name: SocketDesignation
fields.description: String Number for Reference Designation EXAMPLE: CACHE1, 0

fields.name: CacheConfiguration
fields.description: Bits 15:10 Reserved, must be zero Bits 9:8 Operational Mode 00b Write Through 01b Write Back 10b Varies with Memory Address 11b Unknown Bit 7 Enabled/Disabled (at boot time) 1b Enabled 0b Disabled Bits 6:5 Location, relative to the CPU module: 00b Internal 01b External 10b Reserved 11b Unknown Bit 4 Reserved, must be zero Bit 3 Cache Socketed 1b Socketed 0b Not Socketed Bits 2:0 Cache Level 1 through 8 (For example, an L1 cache would use value 000b and an L3

fields.name: MaximumCacheSize
fields.description: Maximum size that can be installed Bit 15 Granularity 0 1K granularity 1 64K granularity Bits 14:0 Max size in given granularity For multi-core processors, the cache size for the different levels of the cache (L1, L2, L3) is the total amount of cache per level per processor socket. The cache size is independent of the core count. For example, the cache size is 2 MB for both a dual core processor with a 2 MB L3 cache shared between the cores and a dual core processor with 1 MB L3 cache (non-shared) per core.

fields.name: InstalledSize
fields.description: Same format as Max Cache Size field; set to 0 if no cache is installed.

fields.name: CacheSpeed
fields.description: The cache module speed, in nanoseconds. The value is 0 if the speed is unknown.

fields.name: ErrorCorrectionType
fields.description: The error-correction scheme supported by this cache component

fields.name: SystemCacheType
fields.description: The logical type of cache

fields.name: Associativity
fields.description: The associativity of the cache.

fields.name: MaximumCacheSize2
fields.description: Extended maximum cache size. Used when MaximumCacheSize is FFFFh. Bit 31 selects 64 KB granularity; otherwise the value is in KB.

fields.name: InstalledSize2
fields.description: Extended installed cache size. Used when InstalledSize is FFFFh. Bit 31 selects 64 KB granularity; otherwise the value is in KB.

fields.name: ExternalReferenceDesignator

fields.name: SlotType

fields.name: SlotLength

fields.name: SlotID
fields.description: The Slot ID field of the System Slot structure provides a mechanism to correlate the physical attributes of� the slot to its logical access method (which varies based on the Slot Type field).

fields.name: SlotCharacteristics1

fields.name: SlotCharacteristics2

fields.name: SegmentGroupNumber
fields.description: For slots that are not of types PCI, AGP, PCI-X, or PCI-Express that do not have bus/device/function information, 0FFh should be populated in the fields of Segment Group Number, Bus Number, Device/Function Number. Segment Group Number is defined in the PCI Firmware Specification. The value is 0 for a single-segment topology.

fields.name: BusNumber
fields.description: Bus number for this slot. For slot types without bus/device/function information, this field is set to FFh.

fields.name: DeviceFunctionNumber
fields.description: Bits 7:3 device number Bits 2:0 function number

fields.name: DataBusWidth
fields.description: Electrical width of the slot data bus.

fields.name: PeerGroupingCount

name: System Event Log
brief: Event-log layout, access method and supported descriptors.

fields.name: LogAreaLength
fields.description: Length, in bytes, of the overall event log area.

fields.name: LogHeaderStartOffset
fields.description: Starting offset within nonvolatile storage of the event log header.

fields.name: LogDataStartOffset
fields.description: Starting offset within nonvolatile storage of the first event log data byte.

fields.name: AccessMethod
fields.description: Location and method used by higher-level software to access the log area.

fields.name: LogStatus

fields.name: LogChangeToken

fields.name: AccessMethodAddress

fields.name: LengthOfEachLogTypeDescriptor

name: Physical Memory Array
brief: Memory-array location, purpose, capacity and error correction.

fields.name: Location
fields.description: The physical location of the Memory Array, whether on the system board or an add-in board.

fields.name: Use
fields.description: The function for which the array is used.

fields.name: MemoryErrorCorrection
fields.description: The primary hardware error correction or detection method supported by this memory array.

fields.name: MaximumCapacity
fields.description: The maximum memory capacity, in kilobytes, for this array. If the capacity is not represented in this field, then this field contains 8000 0000h and the Extended Maximum Capacity field should be used. Values 2 TB (8000 0000h) or greater must be represented in the Extended Maximum Capacity field.

fields.name: MemoryErrorInformationHandle
fields.description: The handle, or instance number, associated with any error that was previously detected for the array. If the system does not provide the error information structure, the field contains FFFEh; otherwise, the field contains either FFFFh (if no error was detected) or the handle of the errorinformation structure.

fields.name: NumberofMemoryDevices
fields.description: The number of slots or sockets available for Memory Devices in this array. This value represents the number of Memory Device structures that comprise this Memory Array. Each Memory Device has a reference to the owning Memory Array.

fields.name: ExtendedMaximumCapacity
fields.description: The maximum memory capacity, in bytes, for this array. This field is only valid when the Maximum Capacity field contains 8000 0000h. When Maximum Capacity contains a value that is not 8000 0000h, Extended Maximum Capacity must contain zeros.

name: Memory Device
brief: Individual memory modules, locators, capacity, technology and speed.

fields.name: PhysicalMemoryArrayHandle
fields.description: The handle, or instance number, associated with the Physical Memory Array to which this device belongs

fields.name: MemoryErrorInformationHandle
fields.description: The handle, or instance number, associated with any error that was previously detected for the device. if the system does not provide the error information structure, the field contains FFFEh; otherwise, the field contains either FFFFh (if no error was detected) or the handle of the errorinformation structure.

fields.name: TotalWidth
fields.description: The total width, in bits, of this memory device, including any check or error-correction bits. If there are no error-correction bits, this value should be equal to Data Width. If the width is unknown, the field is set to FFFFh.

fields.name: DataWidth
fields.description: The data width, in bits, of this memory device. A Data Width of 0 and a Total Width of 8 indicates that the device is being used solely to provide 8 errorcorrection bits. If the width is unknown, the field is set to FFFFh.

fields.name: Size
fields.description: The size of the memory device. If the value is 0, no memory device is installed in the socket; if the size is unknown, the field value is FFFFh. If the size is 32 GB-1 MB or greater, the field value is 7FFFh and the actual size is stored in the Extended Size field. The granularity in which the value is specified depends on the setting of the most-significant bit (bit 15). If the bit is 0, the value is specified in megabyte units; if the bit is 1, the value is specified in kilobyte units. For example, the value 8100h identifies a 256 KB memory device and

fields.name: FormFactor
fields.description: The implementation form factor for this memory device.

fields.name: DeviceSet
fields.description: Identifies when the Memory Device is one of a set of Memory Devices that must be populated with all devices of the same type and size, and the set to which this device belongs. A value of 0 indicates that the device is not part of a set; a value of FFh indicates that the attribute is unknown. NOTE: A Device Set number must be unique within the context of the Memory Array containing this Memory Device.

fields.name: DeviceLocator
fields.description: The string number of the string that identifies the physically-labeled socket or board position where the memory device is located EXAMPLE: SIMM 3

fields.name: BankLocator
fields.description: The string number of the string that identifies the physically labeled bank where the memory device is located, EXAMPLE: Bank 0 or A

fields.name: MemoryType
fields.description: The type of memory used in this device

fields.name: TypeDetail
fields.description: Additional detail on the memory device type;

fields.name: Speed
fields.description: Identifies the maximum capable speed of the device, in megahertz (MHz). If the value is 0, the speed is unknown. NOTE: n MHz = (1000 / n) nanoseconds (ns)

fields.name: Manufacturer
fields.description: String number for the manufacturer of this memory device

fields.name: SerialNumber
fields.description: String number for the serial number of this memory device. This value is set by the manufacturer and normally is not changeable.

fields.name: AssetTag
fields.description: String number for the asset tag of this memory device

fields.name: PartNumber
fields.description: String number for the part number of this memory device. This value is set by the manufacturer and normally is not changeable.

fields.name: Attributes
fields.description: Bits 7-4: reserved Bits 3-0: rank Value=0 for unknown rank information

fields.name: ExtendedSize
fields.description: The extended size of the memory device (complements the Size field at offset 0Ch)

fields.name: ConfiguredMemoryClockSpeed
fields.description: Identifies the configured clock speed to the memory device, in megahertz (MHz). If the value is 0, the speed is unknown. NOTE: n MHz = (1000 / n) nanoseconds (ns)

fields.name: MinimumVoltage
fields.description: Minimum operating voltage for this device, in millivolts If the value is 0, the voltage is unknown.

fields.name: MaximumVoltage
fields.description: Maximum operating voltage for this device, in millivolts If the value is 0, the voltage is unknown.

fields.name: ConfiguredVoltage
fields.description: Configured voltage for this device, in millivolts If the value is 0, the voltage is unknown.

fields.name: MemoryTechnology
fields.description: Identifies the technology of the memory device.

fields.name: MemoryOperatingModeCapability
fields.description: Bit field that describes supported volatile and persistent memory modes.

fields.name: FirmwareVersion
fields.description: String number for the firmware version of this memory device.

fields.name: ModuleManufacturerID
fields.description: Manufacturer ID for the memory module.

fields.name: ModuleProductID
fields.description: Product ID for the memory module.

fields.name: MemorySubsystemControllerManufacturerID
fields.description: Manufacturer ID for the memory subsystem controller.

fields.name: MemorySubsystemControllerProductID
fields.description: Product ID for the memory subsystem controller.

fields.description: Size of the non-volatile portion of the memory device in bytes.

fields.name: VolatileSize

name: Memory Array Mapped Address
brief: Address ranges mapped to physical memory arrays.

fields.name: StartingAddress
fields.description: The physical address, in kilobytes, of a range of memory mapped to the specified Physical Memory Array. When the field value is FFFF FFFFh, the actual address is stored in the Extended Starting Address field. When this field contains a valid address, Ending Address must also contain a valid address. When this field contains FFFF FFFFh, Ending Address must also contain FFFF FFFFh.

fields.name: EndingAddress
fields.description: The physical ending address of the last kilobyte of a range of addresses mapped to the specified Physical Memory Array. When the field value is FFFF FFFFh and the Starting Address field also contains FFFF FFFFh, the actual address is stored in the Extended Ending Address field. When this field contains a valid address, Starting Address must also contain a valid address.

fields.name: MemoryArrayHandle
fields.description: The handle, or instance number, associated with the Physical Memory Array to which this address range is mapped. Multiple address ranges can be mapped to a single Physical Memory Array.

fields.name: PartitionWidth
fields.description: Identifies the number of Memory Devices that form a single row of memory for the address partition defined by this structure

fields.name: ExtendedStartingAddress
fields.description: The physical address, in bytes, of a range of memory mapped to the specified Physical Memory Array. This field is valid when Starting Address contains the value FFFF FFFFh. If Starting Address contains a value other than FFFF FFFFh, this field contains zeros. When this field contains a valid address, Extended Ending Address must also contain a valid address.

fields.name: ExtendedEndingAddress
fields.description: The physical ending address, in bytes, of the last of a range of addresses mapped to the specified Physical Memory Array. This field is valid when both Starting Address and Ending Address contain the value FFFF FFFFh. If Ending Address contains a value other than FFFF FFFFh, this field contains zeros. When this field contains a valid address, Extended Starting Address must also contain a valid address.

name: Memory Device Mapped Address
brief: Address ranges mapped to individual memory devices.

fields.name: StartingAddress
fields.description: The physical address, in kilobytes, of a range of memory mapped to the referenced Memory Device. When the field value is FFFF FFFFh the actual address is stored in the Extended Starting Address field. When this field contains a valid address, Ending Address must also contain a valid address. When this field contains FFFF FFFFh, Ending Address must also contain FFFF FFFFh.

fields.name: EndingAddress
fields.description: The physical ending address of the last kilobyte of a range of addresses mapped to the referenced Memory Device. When the field value is FFFF FFFFh the actual address is stored in the Extended Ending Address field. When this field contains a valid address, Starting Address must also contain a valid address.

fields.name: MemoryDeviceHandle
fields.description: The handle, or instance number, associated with the Memory Device structure to which this address range is mapped. Multiple address ranges can be mapped to a single Memory Device.

fields.name: MemoryArrayMappedAddressHandle
fields.description: The handle, or instance number, associated with the Memory Array Mapped Address structure to which this device address range is mapped. Multiple address ranges can be mapped to a single Memory Array Mapped Address.

fields.name: PartitionRowPosition
fields.description: Identifies the position of the referenced Memory Device in a row of the address partition. For example, if two 8-bit devices form a 16-bit row, this fields value is either 1 or 2. The value 0 is reserved. If the position is unknown, the field contains FFh.

fields.name: InterleavePosition
fields.description: The position of the referenced Memory Device in an interleave. The value 0 indicates noninterleaved, 1 indicates first interleave position, 2 the second interleave position, and so on. If the position is unknown, the field contains FFh. EXAMPLES: In a 2:1 interleave, the value 1 indicates the device in the even position. In a 4:1 interleave, the value 1 indicates the first of four possible positions.

fields.name: InterleavedDataDepth
fields.description: The maximum number of consecutive rows from the referenced Memory Device that are accessed in a single interleaved transfer. If the device is not part of an interleave, the field contains 0; if the interleave configuration is unknown, the value is FFh. EXAMPLES: If a device transfers two rows each time it is read, its Interleaved Data Depth is set to 2. If that device is 2:1 interleaved and in Interleave Position 1, the rows mapped to that device are 1, 2, 5, 6, 9, 10, etc.

fields.name: ExtendedStartingAddress
fields.description: The physical address, in bytes, of a range of memory mapped to the referenced Memory Device. This field is valid when Starting Address contains the value FFFF FFFFh. If Starting Address contains a value other than FFFF FFFFh, this field contains zeros. When this field contains a valid address, Extended Ending Address must also contain a valid address.

fields.name: ExtendedEndingAddress
fields.description: The physical ending address, in bytes, of the last of a range of addresses mapped to the referenced Memory Device. This field is valid when both Starting Address and Ending Address contain the value FFFF FFFFh. If Ending Address contains a value other than FFFF FFFFh, this field contains zeros. When this field contains a valid address, Extended Starting Address must also contain a valid address.

name: Portable Battery
brief: Battery identity, chemistry, design capacity and voltage.

fields.name: Location
fields.description: The number of the string that identifies the location of the battery EXAMPLE: in the back, on the left-hand side

fields.name: Manufacturer
fields.description: The number of the string that names the company that manufactured the battery

fields.name: ManufacturerDate
fields.description: The number of the string that identifies the date on which the battery was manufactured. Version 2.2+ implementations that use a Smart Battery set this field to 0 (no string) to indicate that the SBDS Manufacture Date field contains the information.

fields.name: SerialNumber
fields.description: The number of the string that contains the serial number for the battery. Version 2.2+ implementations that use a Smart Battery set this field to 0 (no string) to indicate that the SBDS Serial Number field contains the information.

fields.name: DeviceName
fields.description: The number of the string that names the battery device EXAMPLE: DR-36

fields.name: DeviceChemistry
fields.description: Identifies the battery chemistry; Version 2.2+ implementations that use a Smart Battery set this field to 02h (Unknown) to indicate that the SBDS Device Chemistry field contains the information.

fields.name: DesignCapacity
fields.description: The design capacity of the battery in mWatthours. If the value is unknown, the field contains 0. For version 2.2+ implementations, this value is multiplied by the Design Capacity Multiplier to produce the actual value.

fields.name: DesignVoltage
fields.description: The design voltage of the battery in mVolts. If the value is unknown, the field contains 0.

fields.name: SBDSVersionNumber
fields.description: The number of the string that contains the Smart Battery Data Specification version number supported by this battery. If the battery does not support the function, no string is supplied.

fields.name: MaximumErrorInBatteryData
fields.description: The maximum error (as a percentage in the range 0 to 100) in the Watt-hour data reported by the battery, indicating an upper bound on how much additional energy the battery might have above the energy it reports having. If the value is unknown, the field contains FFh.

fields.name: SBDSSerialNumber
fields.description: The 16-bit value that identifies the batterys serial number. This value, when combined with the Manufacturer, Device Name, and Manufacture Date uniquely identifies the battery. The Serial Number field must be set to 0 (no string) for this field to be valid.

fields.name: SBDSManufacturerDate
fields.description: The date the cell pack was manufactured, in packed format: Bits 15:9 Year, biased by 1980, in the range 0 to 127 Bits 8:5 Month, in the range 1 to 12 Bits 4:0 Date, in the range 1 to 31 EXAMPLE: 01 February 2000 would be identified as 0010 1000 0100 0001b (0x2841) The Manufacture Date field must be set to 0 (no string) for this field to be valid.

fields.name: SBDSDeviceChemistry
fields.description: The number of the string that identifies the battery chemistry (for example, PbAc). The Device Chemistry field must be set to 02h (Unknown) for this field to be valid.

fields.name: DesignCapacityMultiplier
fields.description: The multiplication factor of the Design Capacity value, which assures that the mWatt hours value does not overflow for SBDS implementations. The multiplier default is 1, SBDS implementations use the value 10 to correspond to the data as returned from the SBDS Function 18h.
